notes.title: New Difficulties, Achievements, and more!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dive into the all new difficulty update[/b][/h2]
[h3]Select how challenging you want your playthrough to be. Earn new achievements and conquer the hardest mode![/h3]

[h3][b]This update includes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Three new difficulties to start your playthrough with
[*] Two new steam achievements
[*] New feature to help you keep track of order inventory
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

Enjoy the new difficulty options and push the limits of your operation!
